steps.name: admissibility
steps.rule: drop every method whose preregistered support gate refused it (isotonic)

steps.name: log_loss_non_degradation
steps.rule: keep every admissible method whose out-of-fold log loss stays within the preregistered tolerance of the best admissible family, so a method can never be retained by improving calibration at the cost of the predictive distribution

steps.name: calibration_quality
steps.rule: among the survivors, keep the methods within the preregistered ECE tolerance of the best

steps.name: brier
steps.rule: among the survivors, keep the methods within the Brier tolerance of the best

steps.name: simplicity
steps.rule: among the survivors, keep the lowest predeclared complexity rank

guards.isotonic_fallback_documented: a refused isotonic is never applied and never scored: the refusal is persisted verbatim and the retained method is selected among the admissible members of the comparison plus the uncalibrated baseline
guards.validation_recalibration_refusal_proof: assert_train_only raises CalibrationError for any VALIDATION or TEST record; tests/preflop/test_generalized_response_calibration.py exercises the refusal

harness.architecture_selection_rule: the headline `retained_method` is the method retained for the architecture the #421 harness ranked first on TRAIN out-of-fold evidence; every calibrated architecture still carries its own retained method
harness.integration: the calibration folds, strata classifier and metric definitions are the #421 harness ones; the harness module is consumed, not rewritten, because its digest is pinned by frozen #421 evidence

metric_definitions.expected_calibration_error: equal-count reliability bins per action class (frozen T2 definition of tools/training/validate_hierarchical_validation.py::expected_calibration_error): for each action, sort rows by predicted probability, cut 10 equal-count bins, accumulate bin-mass-weighted |mean predicted - mean observed| and average over the four action classes

no_leak.assertion: assert not (holdout_hands_i & train_hands_i) for every fold i, and assert the holdout hand sets partition the hand universe

train_cv_report_consistency.definition: absolute delta between this module's uncalibrated out-of-fold metric surface and the #421 harness report, plus the equality of both surfaces at the precision the harness persists

justification.hierarchical_empirical_bayes_dirichlet: retained `isotonic` for architecture `hierarchical_empirical_bayes_dirichlet` on TRAIN out-of-fold evidence only: ECE 0.013236, log loss 1.215723 bits/decision, Brier 0.511761, complexity rank 3; uncalibrated baseline ECE 0.037895, log loss 1.278143. The decision used TRAIN out-of-fold evidence only; VALIDATION and TEST were not consumed and no calibration is applied on VALIDATION (validation_consumed=false, test_consumed=false).
justification.regularized_multinomial_spline: retained `isotonic` for architecture `regularized_multinomial_spline` on TRAIN out-of-fold evidence only: ECE 0.012032, log loss 1.215171 bits/decision, Brier 0.509059, complexity rank 3; uncalibrated baseline ECE 0.024187, log loss 1.259893. The decision used TRAIN out-of-fold evidence only; VALIDATION and TEST were not consumed and no calibration is applied on VALIDATION (validation_consumed=false, test_consumed=false).

protocol.calibration_fit_rule: fitted on the frozen cross-validation model's own predictions on the fold's fit rows (provenance=in_fold_fit); the in-fold calibration sample is the canonically ordered fit fold walked with stride ceil(fit_rows/12000) (or the whole fit fold when it is smaller than the cap)

definitions.isotonic: per action class, a monotone map from the predicted probability to the observed frequency (pool-adjacent-violators knots read by linear interpolation, extended towards the identity anchors (0, 0) and (1, 1) outside the fitted range so a probability outside the in-fold knots is never mapped to a fabricated extreme), renormalised across the legal actions; only fitted when the preregistered support floor is met
definitions.temperature_scaling: q(a) proportional to p(a)^(1/T) restricted to the legal actions, T fitted in-fold by minimising the in-fold multiclass log loss over a fixed log-spaced grid refined by a fixed golden-section search
definitions.vector_scaling: q(a) proportional to exp(scale(a) * log p(a) + bias(a)) restricted to the legal actions; the eight parameters start at the identity (scale=1, bias=0) and are fitted in-fold by 150 fixed gradient-descent steps (learning rate 1.0, L2 0.0001 towards the identity), a deterministic descent on a convex objective

protocol.evaluation_rule: every reported metric is computed on the held-out fold of the same hand-grouped split the architecture was fitted on (provenance=out_of_fold_holdout)

isotonic.admission_rule: isotonic is admitted iff the in-fold calibration sample has at least 500 rows, every action class has at least 50 observed positives and at least 100 decisions where it was legal, and every class shows at least 5 distinct predicted probabilities
isotonic.on_refusal: a refused isotonic is never applied and never scored: the refusal is persisted verbatim and the retained method is selected among the admissible members of the comparison plus the uncalibrated baseline

metrics.brier_score: mean sum over the four actions of (P(action) - 1[observed])^2
metrics.expected_calibration_error: equal-count reliability bins per action class (frozen T2 definition of tools/training/validate_hierarchical_validation.py::expected_calibration_error): for each action, sort rows by predicted probability, cut 10 equal-count bins, accumulate bin-mass-weighted |mean predicted - mean observed| and average over the four action classes
metrics.log_loss_bits_per_decision: mean -log2 P(observed action), base-2 bits per decision
metrics.strata_definition: held-out decisions stratified by the fit-fold support of their exact context signature (exact_context_key): frequent_exact = support >= 20, rare_exact = 1 <= support < 20, exact_absent_in_domain = support == 0 while every single-feature node label is observed in the fit fold, exact_absent_out_of_domain = support == 0 with at least one unseen feature value

no_leak.assertion: assert not (holdout_hands_i & train_hands_i) for every fold i, and assert the holdout hand sets partition the hand universe

no_validation_recalibration.enforcement: fit_calibration/calibrate_record call assert_train_only, which raises CalibrationError on any record whose split is VALIDATION or TEST; the loader is the harness TRAIN-only reader
